Complete Favorites/Wishlist feature with comprehensive testing

## Summary

Implemented a complete many-to-many user-product relationship \(Favorites/Wishlist\) 
feature for NestJS API with 108 comprehensive tests and proper TypeScript typing.

## Changes

### Database \(Prisma\)
- Added UserFavorite join table with userId, productId, notes fields
- Configured cascade deletes and unique constraints
- Created migration: 20260201194630_add_user_favorites

### Favorites Module
- FavoritesController with 5 REST endpoints \(nested routes\)
- FavoritesService with CRUD operations
- DTOs for input validation \(AddFavoriteDto, UpdateFavoriteDto\)
- Proper error handling \(NotFoundException, ConflictException\)
- Status codes: 201 \(created\), 200 \(ok\), 204 \(no content\)

### Testing Infrastructure
- 4 properly typed mock factories \(no `any` types\):
  * prisma.service.mock.ts - PrismaService mock
  * users.service.mock.ts - UsersService mock
  * products.service.mock.ts - ProductsService mock
  * favorites.service.mock.ts - FavoritesService mock
- Uses TypeScript mapped types: [K in keyof Service]: MockedFunction<Service[K]>
- Test utilities: setup.ts, factories.ts for test data generation

### Test Coverage \(108 tests total\)
- Unit Tests: 30 tests \(3 service files\)
- Integration Tests: 33 tests \(3 controller files\)
- E2E Tests: 45 tests \(3 complete workflows\)
- Tests for error handling, cascade deletes, unique constraints

### Documentation
- IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md - Complete overview and architecture
- TESTING_GUIDELINES.md - Best practices for typed mocks and why to avoid `any`
- Updated README.md with Favorites endpoints and pnpm scripts

## Key Features
✅ No `any` types - Full TypeScript type safety
✅ Proper mock factories with mapped types
✅ Complete error handling
✅ Cascade delete constraints
✅ Unique constraint on [userId, productId]
✅ Nested RESTful routes
✅ Comprehensive test coverage
✅ pnpm as package manager \(no npm\)

1. Run: pnpm db:docker:up

3. Manual testing with curl/Postman
